description_en: Authorizes a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance to communicate with a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 将智能接入网关实例授权给跨账号的云连接网实例
kebab_example: aliyun smartag grant-sag-instance-to-ccn --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-tzirqx07bvcngm0000 --ccn-instance-id ccn-n2935s1mnwv8i00000 --ccn-uid 1210123456123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GrantSagInstanceToCcn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CCN instance
parameters.name: ccn_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CCN instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 云连接网实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: ccn_uid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to grant the CCN instance permissions to manage network traffic from the SAG instance.

After the CCN instance is granted the permissions, the CCN instance can redirect the network traffic sent from the SAG instance to the Internet to Cloud Security Access Service (CSAS) for security audit.

true: grants permissions.
false: does not grant permissions.

If you set the value to true and the SAG instance connected to the CCN instance has the secure rerouting feature enabled, you cannot revoke the permissions
parameters.help_zh:
是否给跨账号的云连接网实例授权智能接入网关实例的流量服务能力。

授权成功后，跨账号云连接网实例可以引导智能接入网关实例去往公网的流量做安全审计。

true：授权。
false：不授权。

在您授权成功后，如果智能接入网关实例开启了安全引流功能，则不允许取消授权
parameters.name: grant_traffic_service

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the permission policy
InstanceId.description_zh: 授权成功后返回的授权实例ID
